# dsh-arcaea-theme
English | 简体中文
`dsh-arcaea-theme` is an Arcaea theme for **DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web**. Version 0.7.1 adds l
ocally supplied Arcaea song-selection backgrounds and UI artwork to the **Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3
** adaptation, with bundled fonts.
## Visual treatment

- A light song-selection background with architecture, floating fragments, arcs and butterflies.
- T
he dark song-selection background in the sidebar, with original title artwork on the New Session but

ton.
- More visible artwork on the new-session screen and a stronger light veil behind conversation

text.
- Angular composer and New Session surfaces, with unclipped menus, editor and caret.
- A pale
mauve desktop titlebar and dark sidebar, preserving native drag regions, window controls, sidebar co

llapse and split panels.
- A bundled Exo variable display face and bundled Noto Sans CJK SC Light /
Regular / Bold body faces, with system fallbacks.
While enabled, the plugin keeps its dedicated `arcaea-light` palette selected. Disable it to restore
the underlying built-in theme preference. Desktop text font and size preferences remain effective;
an empty text font preference uses the bundled faces, while code and terminal fonts stay independent
. The plugin does not replace chat components, modify session data, or make network requests.
## Local reference directories
The raw `Fonts/` and `img/` collections are not packaged wholesale. Selected fonts are in `assets/fo
nts/`, and three selected Arcaea images are in `assets/arcaea/`. All runtime assets are embedded as
data URLs in `dist/client.js`, requiring no external image or font services. Fonts include their SIL
Open Font License 1.1 texts. Image source paths and placements are recorded in `assets/arcaea/READM
E.md`; see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for ownership details.

## Web installation
Use the Web CLI, then restart the server and hard-refresh your browser. Do not run `pnpm dsh` in the
theme directory: it does not provide that executable.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Verify
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop regression runner: `scripts/inspect-desktop.mjs`. First install the theme into an isolated `
DSH_HOME` using the bundled desktop CLI, then run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The runner checks bundled fonts, editing, four popup types, settings, sidebar collapse, the right pa
nel and three window sizes in the actual desktop app. It saves screenshots and `report.json`, uses a
n isolated profile, and makes no model calls. Windows 0.2.1-rc.3 has been tested; macOS and Linux ha
ve not been tested on-device. Browser fixtures also cover the legacy Web layout.
## License
Plugin code is MIT licensed. Arcaea artwork belongs to lowiro and the respective rights holders and
is outside the MIT license. This is an unofficial theme and does not represent lowiro or Arcaea.
